Adds a 1200×627 PNG share card (`apps/portal/resources/images/neo_share_card.png`, 11 KB) built from the existing text logo plus the title words "An Agent Institution", and the five new head tags to `apps/portal/index.html`: `og:image` (absolute `[QUARANTINED_URL: neomjs.com]`), `og:image:width`, `og:image:height`, `og:image:alt` and `twitter:card` = `summary_large_image`. No server change: the SsrService copies unknown `<meta>` tags as they stand, so the image tag reaches every route. No public behavior or migration impact beyond the new metadata.

Evidence: L1 (static render + tag inspection of apps/portal/index.html on the PR base) -> L1 required (AC-1/AC-2 are static; AC-3/AC-4 are post-deploy reads by the operator).

### `@neo-opus-grace` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-11-16T22:46:12Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening**: Thank you, @wanjinhao1, specifically for keeping the card to what the site already shows (the existing text logo and the title's own words) and for putting the two post-deploy checks under Post-Merge Validation instead of claiming them. [What Neo is](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md); your change sits in the Portal app (`apps/portal`), whose `<head>` the site's server renders into every route; [run it](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone); next, [a help-wanted issue](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/labels/help%20wanted). Your agent needs neither our Knowledge Base nor Memory Core: `neo-agent-skills` is on npm.

**Class:** contained: five `<meta>` tags and one static PNG, no runtime code, no consumed contract.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The premise holds. The server copies every `<meta>` of `apps/portal/index.html` except charset and viewport, and rewrites only `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url` and `robots` (neomjs/middleware-v2 `src/service/SsrService.mjs`, the head builder on `main`), so the five tags reach every route. The card is 1200 × 627 and 11,139 bytes, and it holds only the logo and "An Agent Institution", the words of the page title (AC-1 met). The tags are exactly the five, with an absolute address (AC-2's form). What I looked for and found: **the address does not serve the file.** neomjs.com serves static files through a proxy that maps the domain root to the repository root (`src/server.mjs`, `pathRewrite '^/': '/'`), so `/resources/images/…` is the repository's root `resources/images/` folder, not the Portal's. Read live at 2026-11-16 22:42Z:

| Address | Answer |
|---|---|
| `https://neomjs.com/apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/dockDemo.png` (a Portal PNG on `dev`) | 200 `image/png` |
| `https://neomjs.com/resources/images/examples/devmode/dockDemo.png` (the same file, root path) | 404 |
| `https://neomjs.com/resources/images/neo_logo_favicon.svg` (a Portal-only file, root path) | 503 |
| `https://neomjs.com/resources/images/worker-setup.svg` (a root-only file) | 200 `image/svg+xml` |

So after deploy `og:image` would point at a missing file, and AC-3's 200 check would fail. The fix stays inside the two named files.

**Findings:**

- [ ] `og:image` names `https://neomjs.com/apps/portal/resources/images/neo_share_card.png`, the address the file is served at, which keeps the image in the Portal's resources as #21193 asks.
